title: Station Need: Ember Gland at the War Citadel (Krynn) filled from the pilot's own glands stored there, about 8,100 cr a gland
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 18:57 UTC (orders ENT-083, block MERCURY: sell handed goods at or above the bids; rule F12 nothing sold under a standing bid). The War Citadel posts Station Need: Ember Gland missions: 2 glands for 16,189 cr and 1 for 8,112 cr twice (get_missions 18:39 UTC), about 8,100 cr a gland against the 7,054 cr bid (2 deep) that sell-loot-at-krynn sells into. Proof by hand (F15, one ship, 18:39 to 18:43 UTC): a trader docked there withdrew its 4 stored glands, accepted the three copies by mission id and handed them in: +8,112, +16,189, +8,112 cr, 32,413 cr for 4 glands (wallet read after each). The runner accepts by title the first copy posted; needs 3 makes every copy seen (1 to 3 glands) completable before it is taken; the redock hands it in; what is left is stored for the next copy or the bid. Before sell-loot-at-krynn in the plan. One ship: the copies are few (three at a time).
